obligations.statement: For any reachable sequence of faithful steps over a rational measure, zero weighted delta at every step preserves that measure.
assumptions: Each step realizes its declared weighted delta.
Every step has zero weighted delta.

obligations.statement: Two abstract one-step query maintainers satisfying their local Correct equations compose into a one-step maintainer for the composed query.
assumptions: Each local operator satisfies its abstract Correct equation under the supplied state addition functions.

obligations.statement: Conjunctive extensions with no new projected writers preserve base safety invariants.
assumptions: Extension initial states project to admitted base initial states.
Every extension step projects to a base step.
Base initialization and each base step preserve the invariant.

obligations.statement: A well-formed law exception tree has exactly one stable (defeasible) labelling at every point, the depth-bounded fold with fuel |exceptions| + 1 decides whether the law is lifted under it, and an exception tree never makes a law bind where its bare law does not.
assumptions: Conditions, scope and response are Boolean denotations at a point; expression evaluation and its refusals are outside this claim (#718 P5).
Well-formed means at most 64 exceptions, unique ids distinct from the law's, and every exception reaches the law by following overrides.

obligations.statement: The extracted norm-precedence decision core admits a declared order exactly when it is admissible (acyclic declared priority, no cross-layer clash, no defeat of a protected law), with an exact closure certificate; it accepts a context's resolution exactly when it is the unique stable survivor set; and every admitted order satisfies downstream-can't-defeat-upstream, strict-layer and overlay preservation.
assumptions: The grounding (masks, layers, protection flags) handed to the core is the declared catalog's; it is the trusted shell TRUST-NORM-PRECEDENCE-SHELL.
Charon/Aeneas translate the production MIR faithfully (TRUST-CHARON-AENEAS-AND-CORE-MODELS).
